name.la: Sermo angelicus de excellencia Marie virginis
name.en-US: The Angelic Discourse on the Excellence of the Virgin Mary
name.pt-BR: O Sermão Angélico sobre a excelência da Virgem Maria

description.la: Sermo angelicus: vinti una lecciones ad matutinas hebdomadae sororum Ordinis Saluatoris, ab angelo dictatae de excellencia Mariae.
description.en-US: The Angelic Discourse: twenty-one lessons for the weekly Matins of the Bridgettine sisters, dictated by an angel on the excellence of Mary.
description.pt-BR: O Sermão Angélico: vinte e uma lições para as matinas semanais das irmãs brigitinas, ditadas por um anjo sobre a excelência de Maria.

sources.edition: Sancta Birgitta, Revelaciones / Opera minora, Samlingar utgivna av Svenska fornskriftsällskapet, Ser. 2, Latinska skrifter VII, ed. Sten Eklund (Stockholm, 1972).
sources.description: Word-file transcription distributed by Documenta Catholica Omnia (also circulated as the Riksarkivet CRB texts), book "XI". Cleaned by research/sourcing/_scripts/bridget_build.py: drop-cap braces and stray quotes removed, hyperlink artefacts removed, the edition's inline verse numbers dropped (paragraphs break at verse boundaries), chapter rubrics kept in italics under each heading.
sources.tierEvidence: Freely distributed online transcription of a medieval text.
